items.name: a blackened smoi leather ashcloak mantled with scarlet rhodochrosites
items.tap: a blackened smoi leather ashcloak mantled with scarlet rhodochrosites
items.description:
The exterior of the ashcloak is thickly caked with layer upon layer of grit, soot and dust.  Set against the mottled greys and blacks is a tiny, pyramid-shaped clasp of inscribed rhodochrosite.
The bright red gems are linked together on a silversteel mesh cape and draped over the shoulders of the long cloak, their faceted surfaces capturing and reflecting all available light in a fiery array of color.  Finishing the design is a pyramid-shaped rhodochrosite clasp set at the throat.

items.description: A block of cambrinth has been carved into the hulking figure of a prowling rimewolf.  Speckles of red congregate in the creature's mane, giving it a chaotic look compared to the rest of the grey-black cambrinth.  The beast's jaws hang open, razor sharp glaes fangs bared in a fearsome snarl.  The rimewolf's eyes are made of Elven gold the pale yellow color of sulfur, looking not unlike the yellowed planet Misueshi.  The rimewolf is the symbol of Misiumos, Albarian goddess of ice.
